(do
  (def memo-call-count 0)
  (def memo-call-cache nil)
  (deftype MemoCallable [] IFn
    (-invoke [this value]
      (do (set! memo-call-count (inc memo-call-count)) (+ value 62))))
  (def memo-call-ordinary ((MemoCallable.) 9))
  (set! memo-call-count 0)
  (def memo-call-first (cljs.core/caching-hash 9 (MemoCallable.) memo-call-cache))
  (def memo-call-hit (cljs.core/caching-hash (throw 31) (throw 37) memo-call-cache))
  (vector memo-call-ordinary memo-call-first memo-call-hit memo-call-count))
